contamination_assessment: This freeze contains no prediction. It exists so that later statements of the form 'the reference of target X was (not) public when Y was computed' can be checked against a time-stamped record instead of memory. Its limit is stated in reference_status: absence of a PDB code is not absence of public information.

notes: targets_classified.csv is derived by this division (target list joined with RCSB release status); the string '31JQ' on the target list is a ligand identifier, not a PDB entry (RCSB: 404), and is not counted.

reference_status.statement: As retrieved on 2026-11-26: the official results page said 'No results available yet'; the download-area directories targets/ and results/ were empty; 19 of 239 targets named a PDB code whose entry RCSB reported as released (release dates 2026-05-27 to 2026-10-07); 9 targets were cancelled; 211 named no PDB code. 'No PDB code on the target list' is NOT evidence that a structure is unreleased: a depositor may have released an entry without the list being updated, and structures may be public through preprints. The predictions of all participating groups were already public in the download area.

title: Public state of CASP17 on 2026-11-26, three days before the announced release of official results: target list, download-area listings, announcements, and PDB release status of the reference structures named on the target list
